analysis:
The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: the 'Last updated' date, a new paragraph under the Sandbox Setup plan step (around head lines 1092-1106), edits to the add-on answer table, and a change near head line 1217. The supplied units are BASE text only (lines 795-1712); the head-side additions were seen only through the truncated patch excerpt. This is documentation with no code, config, endpoint, or control change, so no security regression follows from it.

The new paragraph describes a CLI-side informational line (SandboxSizingPlan.freeSpaceNote) built from plan fields the CLI already parses (free_bytes, floor_bytes, macos_limit). It runs no new network or command path. It adds advice to remove Time Machine local snapshots with tmutil, and that advice is operator-initiated and not executed by the CLI.

The trust boundary is TB-013 / T-061: the CLI downloads and runs install.sh and trusts the add-on's plan event. The base text already says the CLI does not verify the script beyond TLS. The new text does not weaken that statement, but this pass could not confirm it, since the head text was not supplied in full. The plan output is rendered from add-on-controlled JSON, so any new string interpolation in SandboxSizingPlan should be checked in the code review for terminal-escape or injection handling. That code is not in this batch.

The documented base behavior (https-only redirects, 1 MiB cap, 0600 file in a 0700 directory, closed stdin, bounded add-on command timeouts) is unchanged. No findings.
